assessed_tree.note: Grades the Plans tree at this commit; the grade file and report are committed immediately after it.

status_meaning: PASS/PARTIAL/ABSENT/CONFLICT as in the rubric; a PASS grades owner text, never native or runtime proof. Native execution NOT_RUN.
grading_basis: For a registered family whose successor is prepared for the EA-P3 A switch, criteria 2-12 grade the successor contract that the switch would register (the 12/12 the switch requires cannot depend on the switch itself); criterion 1 grades the registered row, and the 3.0.0 membership is graded at the switch. This is the basis S4 uses for prepared families (11 criteria before admission).
oracle_bar: Criterion 12 PASS requires an executable checker whose guard rows are proved by the gated tool (scripts/pm_guard_isolation.py), using the shared number and date-time calls and retained reads from the sealed receipt (PNC019-RUN quality bar; same bar as lane s3b). Authored cases without that checker grade PARTIAL.
